models_evaluated: AI Med Predict (fictitious sepsis risk prediction CDSS)

links.outcome: Effect of explanation of AI risk score on clinician trust in AI CDSS
links.effect: Explainability positively associated with trust in the AI system (β=.508; P<.001; 95% CI 0.258 to 0.758), but also with higher professional identity threat (β=.351; P=.02).
links.quote: We found a significant positive association between AI-based CDSS explainability and trust in such a system (β=.508; P <.001).

links.outcome: Effect of deep workflow integration (specific treatment advice) on trust in AI CDSS
links.effect: Deeply integrated, detailed treatment advice positively associated with trust (β=.262; P=.009); no significant effect on professional identity threat (β=-.072; P=.538).
links.quote: We found a significant positive association between an AI-based CDSS that is strongly integrated into the clinical workflow and trust in such a system (β=.262; P =.009), providing support for hypothesis 2A.

links.outcome: Effect of specifying interventions in response to AI risk output on clinician trust
links.effect: Detailed preventive treatment advice increased trust (β=.262; P=.009) versus unspecific call for preventive activities; no effect on identity threat (β=-.072; P=.538).
links.quote: We found a significant positive association between an AI-based CDSS that is strongly integrated into the clinical workflow and trust in such a system (β=.262; P =.009), providing support for hypothesis 2A.

unlisted_practices: Requiring physician signature to acknowledge AI advice increases professional identity threat (β=.339; P=.004) without changing trust
